Lemma
[Scalar curvature under Ricci flow] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0189 1. Lemma 6.7\group evolution-of-curvature-under-the-ricci-flow

The scalar curvature of a solution to the Ricci flow evolves by \[ \frac{\partial }{\partial t}R=\Delta R+2|\Rc |^2. \]
